content:
I put together Shirika-RPC, a small TypeScript ESM library for typed RPC between a host thread and Web Workers or Node worker_threads.

The runtime path uses SharedArrayBuffer/Atomics for request and response frames, with regular worker messages kept for bootstrap and lifecycle control. The library is not a theorem-proving project, but it has a Lean 4 protocol layer that mirrors and checks the parts I wanted to keep honest: constants, frame layout, codec witnesses, contract hash vectors, and a few finite lifecycle facts.

The repo includes the TypeScript implementation, Node/browser tests, benchmarks, and the Lean sources/fixtures used by CI.

This is still an early/test release, and I am very much figuring out the right shape for it. Feedback, corrections, or suggestions are welcome; if there is interest, I plan to keep developing both the runtime and the Lean side.

https://github.com/eluvane/Shirika-RPC
